senses.gloss: 2. वेल् वेल्, i. 10 (rather a denomin. derived from वेला), Par. To declare the time.

वेल्ल् वेल्ल्, वेल् वेल्, † वेह्ल् वेह्ल्, i. 1, Par.
 1. † To go.
 2. वेल्ल्, To shake, to tremble, Utt. Rāmac. 121, 6.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. वेल्लित.
 1. Shaking.
 2. Crooked, Daśak. in Chr. 198, 19.
 --With the prep. अनु अनु, अनुवेल्लित, Lying crooked under, Daśak. in Chr. 198, 18. n. A bandage used in surgery, Suśr. 1, 65, 17.
 --With उद् उद्,
 1. वेल्ल्, To abscond, Utt. Rāmac. 48, 12.
 2. वेल्, To struggle, Mālat. 140, 3.
 --With वि वि, वेल्ल्, To struggle, to tremble, Kathās. 18, 174.
//Probably akin to Lat. volvo; εἴλω, ἐλύω, [] etc.; O.H.G. wuoljan; Goth. valvjan; A.S. willian, waeltan, etc. (cf. the next).

वेल वेल,
 I. n. A grove.
 II. f. ला.
 1. Time, Pañc. 55, 6; 163, 20; loc. लायाम्, Seasonably.
 2. Tide, Pañc. 75, 24; flow, current.
 3. Sea-shore, Śiś. 9, 38 (at the end of a comp. adj.).
 4. Boundary, Pañc. iii. d. 269.
 5. Leisure, interval, opportunity.
 6. Sudden death.
 7. Sickness.
 8. The gums.
 9. Speech.
 --Comp.

वेल्लन वेल्ल् + अन, n.
 1. Rolling on the ground (as a horse).
 2. A sort of rolling-pin with which cakes, etc., are prepared.
 3. Going.
 4. Shaking.
